page_title: KeyEcho - Lightweight keyboard sound app for Windows, macOS & Linux

summary.name: KeyEcho
summary.one_liner: KeyEcho is a lightweight, open source desktop app that plays recorded mechanical keyboard sounds when you press a key.
use_cases: add mechanical keyboard sound to typing on a laptop
try different switch sounds before buying a keyboard
quiet typing feedback with a soft stroke sound
summary.what_it_does: KeyEcho plays a recorded mechanical-keyboard sample the instant a key goes down, on the machine where it runs. The page says each key has its own press and release recording. It ships as a small native app under 5 MB for Windows, macOS and Linux. Free packs can be downloaded inside the app, and the catalog of Crafted Packs can be previewed in the browser before installing. The page states that nothing typed is read or stored.
notable: Sound is sampled per key with separate press and release recordings
Under 5 MB native app, open source under AGPL-3.0
Free packs included; Crafted Packs previewable in browser
Optional one-time $9.99 unlock for all paid Crafted Packs
caveats: Paid Crafted Packs require a one-time $9.99 unlock for all 53 paid packs; individual packs are $3.99
Unlock is delivered by email key and purchase records are kept until the user asks for deletion
